strings.t: Enskripsyon pou vwayaj entènasyonal yo ouvè 16 oktòb 2026 epi li fèmen 2 novanm, dat kote depo ki pa ranbousab la ak nenpòt demann èd finansye dwe rive tou.

strings.text: The first two trip events are on the school's Global Education calendar; the other deadlines come from the 2027 trip pages and are not on the calendar yet. Global trips are for Middle and Upper School students; the GSD events are for Upper School students in the program, who typically begin it in 9th grade. The three published 2027 trips are Upper School only, for students in grades 9–11 when they register. A nonrefundable deposit is due at registration, and the balance can be paid in full or in two installments. Japan and Iceland take 10 to 16 students and France 8 to 14, with a waitlist after that. Limited financial aid is available toward one global trip during a student's time at Providence Day.
strings.t: De premye evènman vwayaj yo parèt nan kalandriye Global Education lekòl la; lòt dat limit yo soti nan paj vwayaj 2027 yo, epi yo poko parèt nan kalandriye a. Vwayaj entènasyonal yo se pou elèv Middle School ak Upper School; evènman GSD yo se pou elèv Upper School ki nan pwogram nan, ki konn kòmanse l nan 9yèm ane. Twa vwayaj 2027 ki pibliye yo se pou Upper School sèlman, pou elèv ki nan grad 9–11 lè yo enskri. Yon depo ki pa ranbousab dwe peye nan moman enskripsyon an, epi rès la ka peye nèt oswa an de vèsman. Japon ak Islann pran 10 a 16 elèv, epi Lafrans 8 a 14, ak yon lis datant apre sa. Gen yon èd finansye limite pou yon sèl vwayaj entènasyonal pandan tan yon elèv pase nan Providence Day.

strings.text: Families from 57 nations, teachers who speak 20 languages, and a full-time ESL program — the first among the area's independent schools.
strings.t: Fanmi ki soti nan 57 nasyon, pwofesè ki pale 20 lang, ak yon pwogram ESL a plen tan — premye a pami lekòl endepandan zòn nan.

strings.text: Country Day is home to families and students who represent a wide range of cultures and nationalities,
strings.t: Country Day gen fanmi ak elèv ki reprezante yon pakèt kilti ak nasyonalite diferan,

strings.text: and its International Parents Group supports global families who are new to the school, and often new to the country.
strings.t: epi International Parents Group li a ede fanmi entènasyonal ki fèk vin nan lekòl la, e souvan ki fèk vin nan peyi a.

strings.text: the first area independent school to offer it
strings.t: premye lekòl endepandan nan zòn nan ki ofri l

strings.text: The first and only independent school in NC with a full-time ESL program, per the school. It drew 75 international students in its first two years.
strings.t: Premye e sèl lekòl endepandan nan NC ki gen yon pwogram ESL a plen tan, dapre lekòl la. Li te atire 75 elèv entènasyonal nan de premye ane li yo.
International Parents Group

strings.text: Welcomes new international families; runs the International Food Hall at Big Saturday, with dishes from more than 20 countries, and a fall dinner of around 80 members.
strings.t: Li akeyi nouvo fanmi entènasyonal yo; li òganize International Food Hall nan Big Saturday, ak manje ki soti nan plis pase 20 peyi, ak yon dine nan otòn ak anviwon 80 manm.
Diplomat k ap vizite

strings.text: Students have lunched with the ambassadors of Myanmar, Finland, Jamaica, the Czech Republic, Germany and Cape Verde.
strings.t: Elèv yo te manje midi ak anbasadè Myanma, Fenlann, Jamayik, Repiblik Tchèk, Almay ak Kap Vè.
Fèt kiltirèl

strings.text: Lunar New Year with over 1,000 handmade dumplings, and Taste of Cultures, a series begun in late 2024 that reached its 11th event, Lebanon, in spring 2026.
strings.t: Nouvèl Ane Linè ak plis pase 1,000 boulèt farin (dumplings) yo fè ak men, ak Taste of Cultures, yon seri ki te kòmanse nan fen 2024 epi ki te rive nan 11yèm evènman li, Liban, nan prentan 2026.
Klib entènasyonal

strings.text: Model UN and the Global Action Team in Middle School; Model UN, Interact Club, the International Studies Board, World Quest and Euro Challenge in Upper School.
strings.t: Model UN ak Global Action Team nan Middle School; Model UN, Interact Club, International Studies Board, World Quest ak Euro Challenge nan Upper School.

strings.text: Nearly fifty years of global firsts, from a 1977 travel-aid fund to a 2027 program of ten trips and exchanges.
strings.t: Prèske senkant ane premye fwa nan domèn entènasyonal, depi yon fon èd pou vwayaj an 1977 rive nan yon pwogram dis vwayaj ak echanj an 2027.

strings.text: Country Day dates its global program to a 1977 endowment and its first International Studies program to 1988,
strings.t: Country Day di pwogram entènasyonal li a soti nan yon fon dotasyon 1977 e premye pwogram International Studies li a nan 1988,

strings.text: and claims a run of North Carolina firsts since — each below as the school states it.
strings.t: epi depi lè sa a li reklame yon seri premye fwa nan North Carolina — chak youn anba a jan lekòl la di l.
Yon fon pou vwayaj elèv

strings.text: The Mildred Dalton Cox Endowment for International Studies helps students who otherwise would be unable to take part.
strings.t: Mildred Dalton Cox Endowment for International Studies ede elèv ki pa ta kapab patisipe otreman.

strings.text: The first area independent school to offer ESL.
strings.t: Premye lekòl endepandan nan zòn nan ki ofri ESL.
Pwogram International Studies

strings.text: The first International Studies program in Charlotte.
strings.t: Premye pwogram International Studies nan Charlotte.

strings.text: The exchange with King Edward VI School begins.
strings.t: Echanj ak King Edward VI School kòmanse.
Lekòl sè

strings.text: Upper School sister-school partnerships in countries like France and Germany.
strings.t: Patenarya lekòl sè Upper School nan peyi tankou Lafrans ak Almay.
IB Diploma a

strings.text: The first private school in North Carolina to offer it.
strings.t: Premye lekòl prive nan North Carolina ki ofri l.
Echanj Middle School

strings.text: One of the first independent schools in the region to start exchanges at the Middle School level, beginning with a school in Montreal.
strings.t: Youn nan premye lekòl endepandan nan rejyon an ki kòmanse echanj nan nivo Middle School, kòmanse ak yon lekòl nan Monreyal.
Yon bous pou vwayaj pwofesè

strings.text: The J. R. Williams Fellowship funds international travel for a teacher after five years at Country Day.
strings.t: J. R. Williams Fellowship finanse vwayaj entènasyonal pou yon pwofesè apre senk ane nan Country Day.

strings.text: NC's first full teacher exchange with China.
strings.t: Premye echanj pwofesè konplè NC ak Lachin.
Kiba

strings.text: The state's first school to send students to Cuba.
strings.t: Premye lekòl nan eta a ki voye elèv Kiba.
Kebèk

strings.text: The exchange with Externat Saint-Coeur de Marie begins.
strings.t: Echanj ak Externat Saint-Coeur de Marie kòmanse.
Yon poz

strings.text: Global experiences paused; summer 2023 brought the first summer trips since 2019.
strings.t: Eksperyans entènasyonal yo te kanpe; ete 2023 te pote premye vwayaj ete depi 2019.
Dis vwayaj ak echanj

strings.text: Four Upper School trips and six Middle School experiences planned.
strings.t: Kat vwayaj Upper School ak sis eksperyans Middle School ki planifye.

strings.text: Where the program stands out, and eleven questions the school's website doesn't answer yet — Upper School prices, aid, selection and safety.
strings.t: Kote pwogram nan kanpe apa, ak onz kesyon sit entènèt lekòl la poko reponn — pri vwayaj Upper School, èd, seleksyon ak sekirite.

strings.text: Among Charlotte private schools, Country Day stands out for how early and how concretely travel begins — six published Middle School experiences from 6th grade — and for sister-school exchanges running since 1991.
strings.t: Pami lekòl prive Charlotte yo, Country Day kanpe apa pou jan vwayaj yo kòmanse bonè e jan yo klè — sis eksperyans Middle School ki pibliye depi 6yèm ane — ak pou echanj ak lekòl sè k ap fèt depi 1991.

strings.text: A 6th-grade start, with grade, group size and selection published for every Middle School trip
strings.t: Yon kòmansman nan 6yèm ane, ak grad, gwosè gwoup ak seleksyon pibliye pou chak vwayaj Middle School

strings.text: Three sister schools, with homestays both ways
strings.t: Twa lekòl sè, ak sejou lakay fanmi akèy nan toude sans

strings.text: A run of state firsts the school claims: 1988, 1992, 2007, 2015
strings.t: Yon seri premye fwa nan eta a lekòl la reklame: 1988, 1992, 2007, 2015

strings.text: A global community on campus: 57 parent nationalities and full-time ESL
strings.t: Yon kominote entènasyonal sou kanpis la: 57 nasyonalite paran ak ESL a plen tan
Pri vwayaj Upper School.

strings.text: The 2027 Upper School trip prices are not published. What does a trip cost, and what does it include? The Middle School pages list their prices.
strings.t: Pri vwayaj Upper School 2027 yo pa pibliye. Konbyen yon vwayaj koute, e kisa li gen ladan l? Paj Middle School yo bay pri yo.

strings.text: How much does the Cox endowment award each year, and does tuition aid extend to trip costs?
strings.t: Konbyen fon dotasyon Cox la bay chak ane, e èske èd pou frè lekòl kouvri pri vwayaj yo tou?

strings.text: Beyond language priority, how are Upper School places decided when a trip is oversubscribed?
strings.t: Apa priyorite pou lang, kijan yo deside kiyès ki jwenn plas nan Upper School lè gen twòp demann pou yon vwayaj?

strings.text: The director reviews travel partners in person, but no protocol is published. Which vendors are used, what insurance is carried, and what are the chaperone ratios?
strings.t: Direktè a egzamine patnè vwayaj yo an pèsòn, men lekòl la pa pibliye okenn pwotokòl. Ki konpayi yo itilize, ki asirans yo genyen, e konbyen akonpayatè genyen pou chak elèv?
Vwayaj 2025–26.

strings.text: Did Upper School trips run in 2025–26? The live page now lists only the 2027 trips.
strings.t: Èske vwayaj Upper School te fèt an 2025–26? Paj aktyèl la bay sèlman vwayaj 2027 yo kounye a.
Grad pou Lafrans.

strings.text: Is the Middle School France trip open to 7th graders? Its heading says 7th and 8th grade, but its eligibility says 8th grade.
strings.t: Èske vwayaj Middle School an Lafrans lan louvri pou elèv 7yèm ane? Tit li di 7yèm ak 8yèm ane, men kondisyon pou patisipe yo di 8yèm ane.
Jinrui.

strings.text: Is Jinrui School in Shanghai a formal sister school? It is not in the published list of current partners.
strings.t: Èske Jinrui School nan Shanghai se yon lekòl sè ofisyèl? Li pa nan lis patnè aktyèl ki pibliye a.
Resevwa elèv.

strings.text: Are exchange families required to host a sister-school student in return?
strings.t: Èske fanmi ki fè echanj yo oblije resevwa yon elèv lekòl sè an retou?
Lower School ak lang.

strings.text: What global and language curriculum runs before Middle School, and is there a published language sequence from JK to 12?
strings.t: Ki kourikoulòm sou mond lan ak sou lang ki fèt anvan Middle School, e èske gen yon sekans lang ki pibliye depi JK rive 12?
Diplòm.

strings.text: Is a global certificate or diploma planned?
strings.t: Èske gen plan pou yon sètifika oswa yon diplòm entènasyonal?

strings.text: How many students travel each year? The last published figure is 65 Middle School students, in 2018–19.
strings.t: Konbyen elèv ki vwayaje chak ane? Dènye chif ki pibliye a se 65 elèv Middle School, an 2018–19.
